q: bu yıl en çok satan 10 kitap
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
    it."CODE" AS stok_kodu,
    it."NAME" AS kitap,
    SUM(sl."AMOUNT") AS adet,
    SUM(sl."TOTAL") AS tutar
FROM dbo_LG_411_01_STLINE sl
JOIN dbo_LG_411_ITEMS it ON it."LOGICALREF" = sl."STOCKREF"
WHERE sl."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND sl."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND sl."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND sl."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01'
  AND sl."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY it."CODE", it."NAME"
ORDER BY adet DESC

q: 2026 ürün bazında net ciro, en yüksek 3
sql:
SELECT TOP 3 ITEMS.[NAME] AS urun, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8) THEN STLINE.[LINENET] ELSE -STLINE.[LINENET] END) AS net_ciro
FROM (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINENET], [LINETYPE], [STOCKREF], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_01_STLINE] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINENET], [LINETYPE], [STOCKREF], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_STLINE]) AS STLINE
JOIN (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [LOGICALREF], [NAME] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_ITEMS] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [LOGICALREF], [NAME] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_ITEMS]) AS ITEMS ON STLINE.[STOCKREF] = ITEMS.[LOGICALREF] AND STLINE.[__nb_firm] = ITEMS.[__nb_firm]
WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0
  AND STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS.[NAME]
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC
